## History

During his boyhood, James A visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) and grew fond of it. Three years before moving to the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) from Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott to fulfill a promise made to his dying sister, who had worried about his future. However, the couple later separated after his wife gave him an ultimatum to choose between her and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), prompting her to return to her own house.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_
